svg.title: Step 4: 24 V ultrasonic foggers (bigger rooms)
svg.text: For a 75-90 m³ cold room: 3 single-head 24 V foggers, each with its own adapter, switched by the 2 channel relay.
Water tank: 20-30 L box with a lid, in front of the cooler fan. All heads in one tank.
The relay only switches 24 V DC. No 230 V wiring is needed: each adapter stays
Never run the heads dry: they need 3-5 cm of water above the disc. The built-in
float cuts the power when the water is low.
Use demineralised or RO water, otherwise the discs scale up and white dust settles
Do not join the 24 V minus to the ESP's GND. Each adapter is isolated, so it is not
Relay contacts are rated 10 A. Each head draws about 0.75 A, so two heads on
Channel 1 has two heads with their own adapters: both adapter + wires go into COM1
and both head + wires into NO1 (twist them together or use a lever connector). The
